entries.title: Each job has one owner
entries.description: On October 26, 2026, the older assistant names were retired so each job has one owner.
paragraphs: On October 26, 2026, the older assistant names were retired and the jobs that stayed were renamed. Each one has a single owner.
The crew and the job each one holds are listed on the homepage. The longer write-up is the case study on j0sh.wtf.
